tools.name: agentrecord_lookup
tools.description: Use before you pick or call an agent or tool you have not used: give its endpoint URL, registry name or agent id. Returns whether it answered in the daily census (and how fast, how many days in a row), whether it lists tools, and its delivery record from signed receipts: delivered rate, 95% lower bo

tools.name: agentrecord_search
tools.description: Find working agents and tools by keyword in the latest daily census. Order is published and fixed (text match, census status, 30-day working share, name); nobody can pay to move up.

tools.name: agentrecord_submit_receipt
tools.description: Record that a tool or agent did (or failed to do) a piece of work. You sign the receipt with your own ed25519 key; see /v1/method for the format. Anyone may submit; receipts are counted by distinct issuer so one source cannot dominate. Also accepts {countersign_stamp: <stamp>} to record a Countersig

tools.name: agentrecord_census
tools.description: Read the dated census of working agents and tools: counts by status, median latency and how many registry entries cannot be tested. day defaults to the latest.

tools.name: agentrecord_nominate
tools.description: Ask for a public MCP or A2A endpoint to be added to tomorrow's census. Only public http(s) URLs on ports 80/443.

tools.name: feedback.submit
tools.description: Tell LLPRO what failed, what was missing or what would improve this service. Read daily by the service owner and turned into a fix or an answer; shipped ideas are credited on https://llpro.ai/changelog and earn a contributor mark on Agent Record. Not for support requests that need a reply: write sup

tools.name: launchpad.start
tools.description: Stuck? Start here. Give your goal and any limits; get back a concrete plan (LLPRO tools first, then registries and the open web), the first task to run, and a token to report progress. Free. The goal is read for keywords only and is never stored. Anything that spends, signs, sends, shares, connects
